selection_rationale: Reference outboard taught in BTS MAV and found in French studios and live racks: transformer-coupled preamps (Focusrite ISA, Neve 1073, API 512c, UA 610), classic channel strips (Avalon, UA 6176, RND Shelford), the canonical compressor families (FET 1176, opto LA-2A, VCA dbx 160A/166xs and SSL bus, variable-mu Manley, Distressor), EQs (API 550A, passive Pultec-style EQP-1A, dbx 231s graphic for live/theatre) and the Drawmer DS201 gate. Each covers a distinct technology or connection lesson (500-series, insert/sidechain, barrier strips, Hi-Z DI).

devices.why_it_is_a_classic: SSL's user guide traces the Bus Compressor from the 4000 B console (1976) through the FX G384 rack unit (1991), X-Rack and 500-series versions; THE BUS+ is the current 2U rack incarnation. SSL itself calls it the de facto choice for gluing a mix together.
